title: Chapter 535
text:
As an officer of Floating Dragon, Han Xiao was the only member of the armed forces that was active in the outside world. He was no longer a nobody, and information about him was all over the place. Naturally, the model of his mount was not a secret, and many people knew about it.

The spaceships docked at Juberly Hub were all placed in the hangar area, which was connected to the spaceport. From the outside, the spaceport looked like the windows of a skyscraper, densely packed. The spaceships landed in the spaceport and slid into the hangar that corresponded to the number of the spaceport.

The Federation of Light's BlackLight Stealth was like the Bugatti, Koenigsegg, and Lamborghini that sped past on the streets. Many people turned their heads to look at the BlackLight Stealth. It was a high-end and luxurious ship with a sleek body that was as black as a mirror. Befuli easily found out the number of the BlackLight Stealth's hangar after asking around at the Juberly Hub.

"Hangar ad-0074sd, just as I thought. Juberly has arranged a high-end hangar for him."

Befuli clicked his tongue and became more and more excited. The hangar with this number was located in the high-end area, and it was like a good location for a parking lot. The security was tighter, and the facilities were better. For example, Befuli's disguised plundering spaceships could only be parked in a normal hangar with the number 'e'.

After all, Han Xiao was a famous mercenary group in the Garton Star System, and he had been stationed in Juberly Hub for a few years. His spaceship was also a high-end one, so the Hub would naturally give him the best treatment. This made Befuli feel that it was a little troublesome, and the difficulty of snatching the spaceship had increased.

Befuli knew that he did not have the confidence to deal with Han Xiao. Black Star had been in the galaxy for so many years and had proven his strength. A year ago, he had even cooperated with Godora to kill a Calamity Grade Super in Noriose. Befuli did not dare underestimate him at all. As a galactic pirate, one's judgment was very important.

However, Befuli did not intend to give up on his plan. The Blacklight Stealth was too tempting. Black Star was not near the spaceship, so there was no need to fight him head-on. Furthermore, only Han Xiao's identity was verified, which meant that there was no one else on the spaceship. This was the best opportunity.

He didn't dare to fight with Black Star, but he still had the guts to steal.

Befuli led more than a dozen galactic pirates and passed through the complicated corridors of the hangar before arriving at the entrance of the Blacklight Stealth's hangar. In front of them was a thick and heavy alloy door, and they had to be verified before they could enter. However, that was the normal method. The galactic pirates' method was naturally more crude.

Befuli's eyes widened. The crimson color in his eyes started to burn. The solidified flames turned into flowing flames.

Hu, hu — —

The next moment, a thick pillar of fire spurted out from his eyes. The color was orange-red with a hint of blue. It was bright and blazing like a laser. The temperature was extremely terrifying. The heat waves rolled and licked the hangar door. The burned parts quickly turned red and the metal began to soften.

Releasing flames with his eyes was Befuli's special ability, which was also the origin of his nickname. The temperature of the flames continued to increase as he developed his ability. At first, it was only a few hundred degrees, but now, he could release a temperature of thousands of degrees, which was almost equivalent to the surface temperature of a star. It was not difficult for him to burn a hole in the hangar door.

Ka ka ka!

The alarm suddenly sounded. The surrounding walls suddenly slid open, and defense cannons extended out. They aimed at Befuli and opened fire.

The cannons fired, and the galactic pirates all took out their shields. The shields glowed with a yellow light. It was an energy shield that blocked the attacks of the cannons.

The battle suit on Befuli's body quickly transformed into a special heavy armor that covered his entire body. It was mainly for defense, and the cannons could not penetrate the armor. Only his eyes could release energy. Furthermore, the battle suit even had a device that enhanced his eye Esper Ability.

Hu!

The pillar of fire suddenly expanded and gradually turned a deep blue color. The temperature rose again.

Befuli looked around, and the pillar of fire followed his line of sight. It swept past the defense cannons and destroyed them within two seconds.

The alarm was still ringing, and the guards of the hub were on their way. However, Befuli had already burned a hole in the hangar door with his Esper Ability. His efficiency was extremely high.

Walking into the hangar, the Blacklight Stealth quietly stopped in front of the galactic pirates. Everyone had a look of excitement on their faces.

"Hahaha … this spaceship is ours!" Befuli retracted his Esper Ability, and his eyes were filled with greed. He took out his communicator and shouted, "Is the stabilizer ready?"

"No problem, boss. Our spaceship has already left the port. As long as you drive the Blacklight Stealth out of the port, we will be able to drag it away!" The image of the vice-captain appeared on the communicator.

There were two steps to stealing the spaceship. The first step was to enter the hangar and get close to the BlackLight Stealth. They would install a portable thruster and an electromagnetic absorber on the hull of the spaceship to get it moving and leave the spaceport. The second step was to have their own spaceship capture the BlackLight Stealth with an electromagnetic device in space and then escape.

In a short period of time, the galactic pirates were unable to crack the AI system of the spaceship. They used a type of signal jammer that cut off long-distance communication to prevent the owner from remotely controlling the spaceship. As such, the spaceship became a piece of metal that they could do whatever they wanted with it. As long as they captured it, they would have time to modify it.

Even if they could not crack the AI of the spaceship, they could still sell it at a high price in the black market. The Black Lion Spaceship would naturally hire a Mechanic to replace the AI of the spaceship. Basically, every black market ship merchant had a Virtual Mechanic under them.

The galactic pirates were extremely familiar with this process. Basically, every galactic pirate stole a spaceship this way. Befuli's subordinates did not waste any time and quickly took out various devices, preparing to attach the thrusters and absorbers to the spaceship.

On the other side, Befuli threw out a signal jammer that covered the entire Blacklight Stealth. This could temporarily cut off the remote control function. Even if Black Star knew that his spaceship had been stolen, he would not be able to stop it.

"By the time he arrives, we will have already snatched the spaceship."

Befuli smiled and stepped onto the ladder. Flames burned in his eyes as he prepared to burn the hatch open.

He was confident that with the temperature of his eyes, he would be able to burn through the armor of all spaceships other than the defensive ones. The defenses of the spaceship would also not be able to stop a Grade B Super like him.

Therefore, the spaceship was already his!

Boom!

Just as Befuli was about to use his Esper Ability and the galactic pirates were about to attach the devices in their hands to the spaceship, the Blacklight Stealth suddenly moved. Its engine suddenly started, and the high-performance engine completed a microsecond warm-up and acceleration.

Bang!

The Blacklight Stealth directly tore apart the mechanism at the bottom of the spaceship and floated in midair. With an agile 360-degree spin, it threw everyone close to the spaceship out.

Befuli fell heavily onto the wall of the hangar and looked up at the floating Blacklight Stealth. A laser beam was rapidly expanding in front of his eyes.

"What?"

The blinding light swallowed the shocked Befuli.

Boom boom boom!

—
